## Objective
- Finish the existing Stillwater cultivation game and leave it complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- For screenshot checks, save small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; use full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- The earlier apparent mission progress issue came from inconsistent test state; a clean test recorded three wins and mission progress of 3.
- Fixed away-progress accounting to use elapsed whole seconds, preserve stone production remainder and array yields, and reset daily counters consistently when the game day changes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed all seven subviews render; `node --check game.js` passes and browser console has no errors.
- Browser-tested technique upgrades, expeditions and collection, sect joining, mission acceptance/rewards, gear purchase/upgrade, all four alchemy recipes, and breakthrough success/failure.
- Confirmed three combat wins advance and complete the accepted hunt mission.
- Tested defeat recovery: HP restored to 22/65 (35% floor) and enemy cleared.
- Updated away-progress calculation in `game.js`; simulated a long-away save and confirmed the app renders, advances the day, and disables active meditation on return.
- Cleared browser localStorage to restore a clean game state, reloaded, and saved a 1280×800 JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/stillwater-final.jpeg`.
- `node --check game.js` and browser console checks pass.

### Active
- Final verification of save/load away-progress edge cases and review of the implementation for any concrete defects.
- Confirm final UI/browser state and source status.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Inspect the away-progress logic in `game.js` for boundary cases, especially elapsed time spanning multiple in-game days.
2. Run final syntax and browser checks, confirm clean browser state and inspect `git status --short`.
3. Provide a concise completion summary and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, persistence, offline progress, combat, and rendering.
- `index.html`: Game interface and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Game layout and styling.

## Important Context
- Browser localStorage key: `stillwater-cultivator-v1`; cleared and page reloaded after tests.
- Away-progress change in `game.js` is uncommitted; it uses only the last in-game day’s seconds for `qiToday` and `medSeconds`, resetting daily tasks if the day changes.
- Final screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/stillwater-final.jpeg`.
- The earlier test used a manually seeded combat state; defeat recovery passed, with 35% recovery rounded down but clamped to at least 1 HP.
